column1: # name: Band plans of the mesh stacks: a dial and the networks heard around it
# stacks: mesh meshtastic meshcore loraaprs meshcom lorawan
# note: stacks lists the stacks that offer the plan
column2: the first plan of a stack is its first choice. A host tunes to dial_mhz (meshcore_dial_mhz for the stack meshcore) and sets mt_slot_start and mt_slot_end from the row meshtastic_region of meshtastic_regions.csv
column3: the setting channels from the presets of meshcore_group in meshcore_presets.csv (meshcore_default of meshcore_defaults.csv when the group has none) and from ham_presets.csv
column4: and lw_channels from the plan lorawan_plan of lorawan_channels.csv (none when empty).
